sources.title: GitHub - Roboparty/RP1: RP1: An OpenSource Full-Stack Platform for ...
sources.snippet: RP1 is RoboParty's fully open-source humanoid platform: a shared foundation for building, understanding and extending a real robot. The platform brings mechanical and electrical design, joint modules, firmware, robot models, deployment and learning into one connected development stack. Explore a single subsystem, reproduce a build, or develop your own control and learning workflows.
